title: List with Groups
description: Vertical list with collapsible groups (1–2 level shallow grouping). The right choice when groups are headings, not the focus.

tool.name: mount_list
tool.description: Mount a List on the canvas, optionally with collapsible groups. Use for shallow 1–2 level grouping where the items are the focus (settings menus, sidebar nav, command palettes). For deeper hierarchy prefer Tree.

parameters.items: Array of items; group items have a `children` array
parameters.collapsible: boolean — enable expand/collapse on group headers

props.name: fields
props.desc: Remap data keys to component fields

props.name: value
props.desc: Currently selected item value. Two-way — a selection writes it back, so `bind:value` is all you need

props.name: multiselect
props.desc: Select several rows: click selects one, ctrl/⌘-click toggles, shift-click extends a range (Space / ctrl+Space / shift+Space from the keyboard)

props.name: values
props.desc: The selected values when `multiselect`. Two-way — `bind:values`; an outside change re-selects without being reported back

events.name: onselect
events.desc: Fires when an item is selected — receives raw value + ProxyItem. Notification only; `value` is already updated by the time it runs

events.name: onchange
events.desc: Fires once per real change of a multiselect selection, with the new set; `values` is already updated

attrs.desc: Leaf item button/link (data-active, data-selected, data-disabled, data-level)
"true" on every row in a multiselect selection (with aria-pressed)
